svg.text: 1. BASE: PETG, POCKET FOR STEEL DISC Ø120 × 6 (LASER CUT, GLUED).
2. BEARING: Ø100 TURNTABLE BEARING IN Ø101 × 3 SEAT. BALL DETENT AT 0° AND 180°.
3. CABLE: Ø14 THROUGH BASE, HUB AND ARM CENTRE. USB-C REACHES THE SHELL.
4. ARM 40 × 18, 15° BACK TILT. PRINT ARM ON ITS SIDE FOR LAYER STRENGTH.
